verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation feature, such as rules, workflows, or scheduled jobs, that runs autonomously in the background. What it does show are built-in billing behaviors: Stripe invoices created automatically, credit auto-recharge, one-off scheduled seat changes, and outbound webhooks. These are adjacent features rather than an automation capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
